issues.description: Regression_sample.sas is a supplied 555-line entry program, but the root-verified safe view withholds the complete body. The current assessment therefore preserves the program as code-present and leaves sample-builder-specific producer, alias and output-path details unresolved where they cannot be independently supported by the visible companion stages. The mask is not evidence of missing code or data.

In the visible WD_measure program, Hvalue_3 is consumed and tna_3/sizetna are referenced in the output construction, but their exact producer, key, period, unit and construction-history contracts are not established. Confirm the supplied producer and its field definitions; do not infer formulas.

The momentum-adjusted workflow consumes author-specific mom_1 and mom_3 series for three- and six-month windows. The sampled local daily factor table contains standard factors but not these custom fields; exact construction, source, history and timing remain unresolved.

WD_momadj_measure names CRSP2017.dsf while the verified compatible local legacy route is CRSP.DSF. Configure the CRSP2017 libref/path as a same-data alias to that product before execution; empirical coverage remains a route-validation check, and the external CIZ format change does not require conversion of this compatible local route.

The assigned workflow dependency ledger records a WinsorizeTruncate.sas source include. The exact include file, path and macro interface are not established in this safe review; confirm the supplied helper and its expected inputs before running the sample-construction stage.

The separate unbalanced-sample Stata branch consumes finalsam_unbalance with rdate1/rdate2 fields. Its named SAS producer is part of the supplied, code-present sample-construction stage, but the exact output construction and field contract cannot be verified from the fully withheld safe view.
WD_measure creates Hret4 and the holdings output step refers to Hert4. This is a supported same-data spelling correction at the visible handoff.
WD_momadj_measure creates WD6MomAdi while the following join refers to WD6MomAdj. This is a supported same-data spelling correction at the visible handoff.

Regressions.do line 8 retains wd60_v3 but not exact wd6; lines 84–91 collapse and restore wd60_v3, while line 107 uses wd6. StataCorp documents unique variable-name abbreviations, so if abbreviation is enabled wd6 may select wd60_v3. The imported finalsam schema, effective abbreviation setting and intended reference are unverified; adding wd6 to the keep list could change the selected measure.
The later Stata block declares tempfile all but saves and reloads temp1; the earlier all handle is used again later. Declare temp1 at the later block so the original all handle remains available.

evidence.description: The datasheet names the stated source products for holdings, fund returns, stock information and analyst coverage.
evidence.quote:
SEC EDGAR: information on portfolio disclosure dates (i.e., the dates as of which a fund’s
holdings are publicly disclosed) and the filing dates of reporting (accessed in 2017)

CRSP Mutual Funds: information on portfolio disclosure dates, daily and monthly fund returns,
monthly fund flows, and other characteristics of mutual funds (WRDS, accessed in 2017)

Thomson Reuters S12: information on portfolio disclosure dates and portfolio holdings of
mutual funds (WRDS, accessed in 2017)

Other data:

CRSP Stock Files: information on stock returns, stock prices, trading volume, and other
characteristics of individual stocks (WRDS, accessed in 2017)



                                               1

SEC EDGAR: information on confidential treatment requests of mutual funds (accessed in 2021)

IBES: information on analyst coverage of individual stocks (WRDS, accessed in 2021)

evidence.description: The monthly WD stage covers 1998–2012, constructs Price from CRSP.MSF and retains stock identifiers, prices, adjustment factors and returns.
The monthly WD stage selects reporting and vintage dates from TR.S12type1 over the stated range.
The monthly WD stage uses MFL.Mflink2_beg_end, TR.S12type3, CUSIP and NCUSIP to map holdings to PERMNO.
The monthly WD program specifies holding-value weights lagged three and six months for buy-and-hold portfolio returns.
The monthly WD program forms three-month and six-month compounded-return series with exact count requirements.
The monthly WD program creates Hret4 and then attempts to save WD.holdings_wficn from Hert4.
The monthly WD stage reads CRSPF.Monthly_Returns, Monthly_Tna and Fund_Fees with fund and date keys.
The monthly WD stage links CRSP fund classes to WFICN through MFL.Mflink1.
The monthly WD stage saves WD.mret_wficn for downstream use.
The monthly WD stage forms three- and six-month actual return windows before producing WD measures.
The monthly WD stage writes WD.WD_measure and uses tna_3 and sizetna without a visible definition in this program.
The momentum-adjusted stage covers 1998–2012 and reads CRSP2017.dsf for daily stock returns and adjustment fields.
The daily momentum-adjusted stage selects reporting and vintage dates from TR.S12type1.
The daily momentum-adjusted stage uses MFL.Mflink2_beg_end, TR.S12type3 and CRSP.MSENAMES to map holdings to PERMNO.
The daily stage reads CRSPF.Daily_Returns, Monthly_Tna, Monthly_Nav and Daily_Nav to construct daily fund assets.
The daily stage links CRSP fund classes to WFICN through MFL.Mflink1.
The daily stage aggregates class returns and writes WD.Dret_wficn and WD.wd_daily.
The daily stage consumes mom_1 and mom_3 and describes custom three- and six-month ranking windows.
The three-month branch filters a 90-day window and joins the daily momentum fields.
The six-month branch filters a 180-day window and joins mom_3.
The three-month adjusted WD branch applies the stated observation and residual-day filters before scaling outputs.
The six-month output is named WD6MomAdi, while the final join reads WD6MomAdj.

evidence.description: WD_measure joins CRSPF fund style fields to an average portfolio-composition field derived from fund summary data.
evidence.quote:
create table Fund_Style
as select a.crsp_fundno, a.si_obj_cd, a.wbrger_obj_cd, a.policy, a.lipper_class, b.avrcs
from CRSPF.fund_style a left join (select distinct crsp_fundno, sum(per_com)/count(per_com) as avrcs
                                   from CRSPF.fund_summary group by crsp_fundno) b

evidence.description: The semiannual branch collapses and saves wd60_v3, restores the earlier all table, drops the prior measures, and merges the collapsed table back before the later wd6 reference.
evidence.quote:
collapse (sum)wd80_v3 wd3 wd60_v3 wd80_v1 pumpvw1 delayperiod1 (mean)alpha30 (max)rdate (count)n=year, by(wficn h)
	gen delayperiod=log(delayperiod1)
	tempfile semi
	save `semi'

	use `all'
	drop wd80_v3 wd3 wd60_v3 wd80_v1 pump* delay* alpha30
	merge 1:1 wficn rdate using `semi', keep(match) nogen
